Hi Sophie — thanks for sending this over. Looping in Marcus (legal) to review the release and confirm retention. A few quick operational notes from our side:  

- Proposed run-of-show (attached run_of_show_v3.xlsx): intro (5m), product walkthrough (15m), customer use-case (10m), partner segment (10m), live Q&A (20m). We recommend a sponsor 30s pre-roll slate immediately before the partner segment.
- Producer / day-of: Marcus will not be day-of; our recommended producer is Lauren Bishop (cc) — she will own live slide control and ON24/Zoom fallback routing. Lauren: can you confirm availability for dry-run?
- Recording & retention: Redwood is comfortable with a 90-day hosted recording by default; sponsor assets that include third-party content must be removable at sponsor request. Marcus — can you confirm if 90 days + removal-on-request is acceptable legally?
- Technical: ON24 RTMP ingest preferred; please provide the ON24 ticket number and any RTMP keys. If we fall back to Zoom webinar, we need the registration passcode and an SSO link for single-sign-on.

I attached the run-of-show workbook with time allocations and cue points. I also added a small checklist for sponsor creative delivery.

Next steps: Marcus to confirm legal language; Lauren to confirm dry-run slot; Sophie to send ON24 ticket/RTMP keys and sponsor creative.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Thanks all — reviewed the draft_cohost_release.pdf and added redlines (cohost_agreement_redlines.pdf). High-level legal decisions:  

- Public playback: Redwood agrees to a 90-day public hosting window for the event recording.
- Internal archive: Redwood may retain one internal, watermarked copy for training and product review; access will be limited to RedTeam and Legal. This is a non-public copy and will be deleted after 18 months unless otherwise approved.
- Sponsor creative: Sponsor pre-roll will be published as part of the recording unless MediaPlus requests removal in writing within 60 days of publish; we will honor removal requests and purge sponsor assets from public playback within 7 business days.
- Release signatures: We need both parties to sign via DocuSign. Sophie — I left comments where we need MediaPlus signoff on indemnity and footage ownership.

Operational notes: confirm ON24 ticket PRODUCTION-7456 and send the RTMP ingest key privately (do not post keys in thread). For backup: Zoom webinar ID 123-456-7890 (passcode: 4X9bT) is reserved.

I'll upload the redlined agreement and the final checklist. Lauren — Thurs 3 Jun 10:00 PT is OK for the dry-run. Sophie — please confirm and send sponsor creative by Tue 31 May so we have time to prep.

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai
